parameters.query: SELECT s.id,s.device_id,p.name,s.started_at,s.duration_sec,s.turns,s.total_tokens,s.input_tokens,s.output_tokens,s.summary_in_tok,s.summary_out_tok,s.summary_provider,s.transcript FROM care_sessions s LEFT JOIN care_profiles p ON p.device_id=s.device_id ORDER BY s.started_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT provider, model, endpoint FROM llm_config WHERE id=1
